title: Narrow Highway — deterministic verification with receipts
description: Hand any AI agent a claim; get a verdict, the worked trail, and a permanent, independently re-checkable seal. Deterministic math and rules across 60 domains — no model in the loop. 0 false positives on the published benchmark. Free, no key.
